jobs.title: MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office
jobs.description:
MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) \- MPS Dean's Office About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and providing space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Pla n, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

The MPS Dean's Diversity Office initiates, implements, and evaluates efforts and conducts research on student, postdoc, and faculty success in the mathematical and physical science fields with an emphasis on ensuring fair access and equitable outcomes. The Assistant Dean and their staff organize new initiatives, develop new funding, and support departmental efforts to students, and receive all work duties directly from the Assistant Dean. Collaborates with professors, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and administrators from UCB and national partners.
  
  

Currently projects underway include MPS Scholars and the MPS Scholarship Program at the undergraduate level, a doctoral advancement program, and a postdoc study. This position is responsible for providing programmatic, administrative, and financial coordination for MPS Dean's Office. Provides support to the Assistant Dean. The Assistant Dean advises the Deans and Department Chairs, manages and provides assistance to several student organizations, conducts research, develops new programs, and works to enhance equity among the faculty, staff, and students in the MPS departments.
  
  

The position requires in\-depth understanding of campus policies and administrative practices. The position holder is a key point of contact for all MPS Dean's Office business and must be able to work with a high degree of independence with good judgement and follow through.
  
  

MPS Scholars is the official student success and mentorship program of the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, offered collaboratively with the Departments of Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Open to all intended and declared MPS majors, MPS Scholars provides opportunities to build community, explore academic and career pathways, and thrive throughout the Berkeley experience.
  
  

Since launching in Fall 2022, thousands of students have participated in MPS Scholars through mentorship, events, workshops, and academic and career resources.
  
  

MPS Scholars is a structured program, supported by funding from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. It provides activities and opportunities such as: A supportive mentoring network of advanced students, faculty, professional scientists, and alumni. Welcome and orientation programs for incoming students. Research and internship opportunities in academic and industry settings. Career development workshops, courses, networking events, and graduate school preparation. Academic resources designed to support success in MPS majors. Retreats, social events, and community\-building activities that connect students with peers, graduate mentors, staff, alumni, and faculty across the MPS departments.
  
  

The Mathematical and Physical Sciences Scholarship Program (MPSSP) awards up to $15,000 per year in scholarship support to eligible students in Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Funded by the National Science Foundation's S\-STEM program, MPSSP scholars receive financial support while participating fully in the MPS Scholars community.
  
  

At the graduate level, a bridge grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation grant is focused on establishing a prototype for the establishment of a Sloan Center for Systemic Change (SCSC) at Berkeley by establishing a consortium of departments working together to advance their equity goals.
  
  

At the postdoctoral level, the Postdoc Study, supported by a grant from the Heising\-Simons Foundation, is designed to provide a clearer understanding of the experiences of postdoctoral scholars and causes of patterns of career selection among postdocs in the MPS fields at top\-tier universities and national research facilities.
  
  

The MPS Program Coordinator coordinates and administers academic support and student success programs within the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, including MPS Scholars and the NSF S\-STEM Scholarship Program. The position supports the development and implementation of programs designed to enhance the academic, professional, and personal success of undergraduate and graduate students, with particular attention to students who may face barriers to academic success.
  
  

Working under the direction of the Assistant Dean and in collaboration with faculty, staff, students, and campus and external partners, the Program Coordinator provides programmatic support, coordinates mentoring and professional development activities, supports students in navigating academic and other challenges, and assists with program assessment and evaluation. jobs.title: Scaled Enablement Programs Lead
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Anthropic's partners are often the first place an enterprise hears about Claude. The sellers and practitioners inside our cloud, system integrator, ISV and reseller partners are positioning Claude in thousands of conversations we will never be in, and how well they tell that story shapes how customers understand what Claude can do for them. Getting that many people ready, and keeping them ready as our products move, can't happen one partner at a time.



We're looking for a Scaled Partner Enablement Programs Lead to build and run the programs that carry our go\-to\-market motions across the ecosystem. Some of these programs you'll build, including a partner train\-the\-trainer model and a repeatable way to take sales plays to market with partners. Others you'll inherit and make better, including our global partner webinar series and the enablement that prepares Anthropic's own field to sell alongside partners. All of them serve the same outcome, field readiness, meaning sellers on both sides of a deal understand Claude, can position it with confidence, and know how to win together.



This role combines program leadership with program building. Your job is to make these programs repeatable and to build the operating rhythm that keeps them consistent across regions. You'll connect Product Marketing, Sales, Partner Programs, our partner\-type enablement leads, and the Partner Training \& Curriculum and Certification teams.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Build Anthropic's partner train\-the\-trainer model, packaging our most effective training so partners can deliver it to their own teams and extend our reach beyond what our own team can deliver directly
* Build a repeatable way to take focused GTM motions, such as sales plays and launches, to market with partners at scale, working with our partner\-type enablement leads so each play reflects how that partner motion actually sells
* Manage our global scaled partner webinar series and evolve it into the primary channel for launch, product and program messaging to the ecosystem, so partner sellers hear one clear, current story about Claude
* Strengthen how we enable Anthropic's own field on partners, so our sellers understand the value partners bring, know how to co\-sell, and show up alongside us to help these programs scale. This spans field training that lands each new motion, partner content in GTM onboarding, and a central, current home for partner resources
* Run the portfolio as one system, with a shared operating model, content intake and calendar, production standards, and global delivery across regions, time zones and languages
* Lead a team of contractors aligned to specific programs, and keep work coordinated across the many teams that contribute to them
* Track field readiness and define metrics that measure program effectiveness beyond attendance

**You may be a good fit if you have**
-------------------------------------


* Built and scaled 1:many enablement programs for large partner sales and technical audiences at a technology company, across partner types such as SIs, cloud providers, ISVs or resellers
* Enabled a large internal sales organization on new GTM motions, including how to co\-sell with external partners
* Taken sales plays or GTM motions to market through partners and measured their pipeline impact
* Built or run a train\-the\-trainer model that let partners deliver training consistently without you in the room
* Led programs through a team of contractors or vendors, delivering across multiple regions and languages
* Comfort operating where products and messaging change constantly and the underlying operating systems are still being established
* Experience using AI across your day\-to\-day workflows to extend your own scale and reach

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.



For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.


Annual Salary:


$270,000 \- $310,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------


**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience


**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience


**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position


**Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.


**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.


**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important,

jobs.title: Project Manager – Structural Steel Fabrication and Erection
jobs.description:
**Lead Complex Steel Projects That Shape the West Coast**

**Your next project could be one people drive past every day.**


A well\-established structural steel contractor with a strong reputation across the West Coast is looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to take the lead on complex structural steel fabrication and erection projects.


This is an opportunity for a construction professional who knows steel, understands the full project lifecycle, and enjoys having real ownership of schedule, cost, client relationships, and project results.


You’ll work on significant **commercial, infrastructure, aviation, high\-rise, and other complex projects** while partnering with some of the region’s leading general contractors, developers, engineers, and construction professionals.

**Why This Opportunity Stands Out**

**Lead Projects That Matter**  

Take ownership of major structural steel projects from pre\-construction through final closeout—projects that become part of the West Coast’s skyline and infrastructure.

**Be More Than a Project Administrator**  

You’ll have a meaningful role in project strategy, constructability, scheduling, cost management, fabrication, erection, and client relationships.

**Work Across the Entire Steel Project Lifecycle**  

Collaborate with estimating, engineering, detailing, fabrication, transportation, and field erection teams to turn complex designs into successful builds.

**Grow Your Leadership Impact**  

Mentor Project Engineers and junior team members while helping strengthen project execution and develop the next generation of steel construction professionals.

**Join a Stable, Established Organization**  

Be part of a respected company with a strong project pipeline, experienced leadership, and the resources to support complex work.

**Competitive Compensation \& Long\-Term Growth**  

A competitive compensation package and the opportunity to build a long\-term career within an established structural steel organization.

**What You’ll Do**


As Project Manager, you’ll be responsible for driving successful project execution across **safety, quality, schedule, client satisfaction, and profitability**.

**Project Leadership**

* Lead structural steel projects from pre\-construction and contract award through fabrication, erection, and closeout
* Develop and manage project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and project execution plans
* Monitor project financial performance, costs, changes, and risk
* Identify potential issues early and develop practical solutions before they impact the project

**Client \& Project Coordination**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for general contractors, clients, architects, engineers, and other stakeholders
* Build strong working relationships throughout the project lifecycle
* Lead project meetings and coordinate communication between office and field teams
* Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, and other project documentation

**Steel Operations**

* Coordinate with engineering, detailing, fabrication, and erection teams
* Review drawings, specifications, and project requirements for constructability and potential issues
* Participate in Design\-Assist and pre\-construction coordination
* Help develop fabrication schedules and field erection sequencing
* Coordinate procurement, subcontractors, deliveries, and field activities
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress, quality, safety, and coordination

**Team Leadership \& Improvement**

* Mentor Project Engineers and developing project professionals
* Promote accountability, collaboration, and effective communication
* Identify opportunities to improve project execution, productivity, and profitability
* Support Lean Construction and continuous\-improvement initiatives
* Support LEED documentation and sustainable construction practices when applicable

**What You Bring**


We’re looking for someone who combines **strong project management skills with real structural steel experience**.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field **OR 10\+ years of relevant construction management experience**
* Proven experience managing **structural steel fabrication and erection projects**
* Experience with complex commercial, infrastructure, aviation, stadium, high\-rise, or similarly challenging projects
* Strong understanding of **AISC, AWS, and structural steel construction practices**
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, change orders, contracts, and financial performance
* Strong understanding of fabrication, detailing coordination, and field erection
* Excellent communication, negotiation, organization, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while coordinating office and field teams
* Willingness to travel periodically to project sites throughout California

**Preferred**

* Experience with **Design\-Assist** and other collaborative delivery models
* Lean Construction experience
* Experience with **Procore, Tekla EPM, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office**
* Familiarity with LEED and sustainable construction practices
* Previous experience coordinating structural steel detailing and fabrication workflows

**Ready to Take Ownership of Bigger Projects?**


If you’re an experienced structural steel Project Manager looking for **challenging projects, greater responsibility, strong industry relationships, and a company where your experience matters**, this could be the next step in your career.

**Apply today.**


You can apply directly through this platform or through:


Construction Worldwide – Search Jobs

 **Not the right opportunity for you?**  

Register with Construction Worldwide to be considered for future opportunities that match your experience and career goals.

BerryDunn is seeking a **Senior Consultant/Project Manager** to join our **State Government Practice Group**, focused on serving our state Health and Human Services (HHS) agency clients. Ad Hoc is a technology company that empowers organizations to deliver scalable, impactful digital services. Using modern, agile methods, our team creates products that meet people’s needs and transform their experience of government.


**Work on things that matter**


Our collaborations have shaped some of the defining moments in public\-sector service delivery. We’ve helped build products that connect Veterans to tailored services, help millions access affordable health care, and support important programs like Head Start. As we work with agencies to deliver critical services, we’re also changing how the government approaches technology.


### **Built for a remote life**


Our culture, communications, and tools are built for remote work, enabling us to bring together top talent nationwide. At Ad Hoc, remote life empowers our teams to design work environments that fit their lives and that foster flexibility and collaboration to achieve positive outcomes for our customers.

Ad Hoc values acceptance, accountability, and humility. We aren’t heroes. We learn from our mistakes and improve the process for the next time. We build small, inclusive teams to collaborate closely with our partners to solve the right problems and deliver software that works.

**National Account Manager, Electrical Distribution**


**Location:** Americas (Remote)


**Reports to:** Director, North American Commercial Sales

  


**Role Summary**



Fluke's promise to every customer is simple: always give them a little more than they paid for. As National Account Manager, Electrical Distribution, you'll bring that promise to life by supporting and managing key electrical distribution partners — owning account plans, digging into the data, and driving growth through strong relationship management, account execution, and channel development.



This role offers a strong development path into strategic account leadership and broader national account responsibility. You'll own your assigned accounts, with coaching and support from your manager as you build toward larger account ownership over time. It also rewards curiosity — using AI\-enabled tools and account data to spot patterns and turn analysis into smarter, faster growth for the partners you manage.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Account Management \& Planning**


* Manage assigned electrical distribution accounts, owning achievement of sales and profitability objectives.
* Develop and execute annual business plans with distributor partners to drive sales growth and market share gains.
* Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline visibility, and account planning activities.


**Relationship \& Channel Management**


* Build productive relationships with distributor sales teams, product managers, procurement professionals, branch leadership, and operations personnel.
* Partner closely with field sales teams to improve alignment and strengthen execution within assigned distributors.
* Support execution of channel programs, promotions, training initiatives, and marketing campaigns.
* Develop a strong understanding of distributor go\-to\-market models, category management practices, and sales processes.


**Business Analysis \& Reporting**


* Analyze POS, inventory, bookings, and market performance data to identify business opportunities and risks.
* Conduct routine business reviews with assigned partners to evaluate performance against growth objectives.
* Monitor customer, market, and competitor activity, and communicate insights to leadership.
* Utilize AI\-enabled productivity and analytics tools to improve account management effectiveness.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Collaborate with internal teams to resolve customer issues and improve overall distributor satisfaction.
* Support adoption of company programs that improve sales effectiveness and customer engagement.


**Required Qualifications**


* Minimum 3 years of sales, account management, channel management, or distribution experience.
* Experience working with electrical, industrial, construction, safety, HVAC, or industrial supply distributors preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and execute against business objectives.
* Working knowledge of sales analytics, forecasting, CRM tools, and business planning processes.
* Ability to analyze business performance data and translate insights into action plans.
* Comfort collaborating across functional teams, including marketing, sales, operations, and product management.

* Strong problem\-solving, organizational, and project management skills.
* Experience utilizing AI\-assisted productivity and analytics tools.
* Bachelor's degree preferred in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
